description: This file contains a set of shell functions and test cases for a mock Large File Storage (LFS) system integrated with a Perforce (P4) and Git environment. It tests the behavior of cloning repositories, storing large files based on size and extension, and verifying file presence, content, and deletion within a mocked storage setup.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies a specified file exists with expected content and is not stored within the mock LFS storage.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Checks that a specified file is stored as a pointer in the main repository and the actual content exists in local and remote mock storage.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Confirms that a specified file has been deleted in the main repository but still exists in the mock storage as content.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts the number of files in a directory and matches against an expected count.
